description: This file declares the MojoDemuxerStreamAdapter class, which acts as a bridge between a Mojo DemuxerStream remote interface and a local DemuxerStream implementation, facilitating media stream handling in a remote application context.

classes.name: MojoDemuxerStreamAdapter
classes.description: A class that adapts a Mojo DemuxerStream remote interface to a local DemuxerStream, enabling remote media stream handling.

methods.name: MojoDemuxerStreamAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a remote DemuxerStream and a callback for when the stream is ready.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Initiates a read operation on the demuxer stream.

methods.name: audio_decoder_config
methods.description: Returns the current audio decoder configuration.

methods.name: video_decoder_config
methods.description: Returns the current video decoder configuration.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the demuxer stream.

methods.name: SupportsConfigChanges
methods.description: Indicates if configuration changes are supported.
